contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals seeking high-quality visual content creation, including creative directors, video producers, and art directors

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature:-
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

testimonials.quote: Seedream allows us to generate high-resolution creative visuals from simple prompts. It has dramatically reduced our design turnaround time.
testimonials.author: Vaishali Saxena

testimonials.quote: Seedance’s ability to generate synchronized audio and video is incredibly powerful for storytelling and branded content.
testimonials.author: Vihaan Pandey

testimonials.quote: The multimodal editing capabilities in Seedream make it easy to refine images with precision.
testimonials.author: Anurag Malhotra

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width dark hero band with brand/logo lockup, large left-aligned headline stack, short supporting copy, and a simple benefit bullet row beneath the message. No visible split-media treatment in the reference; emphasis is text-first with strong vertical hierarchy.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Hero band followed by a contrasting white form/content block. The page favors clear section breaks, one primary message per section, and a simple linear scroll rather than dense multi-column storytelling.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Utility-led card treatment with solid backgrounds, modest radius, and minimal ornament. Form content sits in a contained card-like panel; feature presentation appears more like stacked content blocks than decorative marketing cards.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Single prominent primary CTA in the hero and repeated conversion intent in the form section. CTAs are direct and action-oriented, with one dominant conversion path rather than multiple competing actions.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not present in the provided reference.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Logo-first hero with no primary product image or media panel. Visual support is limited to small inline icons and checkmarks rather than large illustrations, screenshots, or videos.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Product content is organized as sequential feature sections with a label, headline, descriptive paragraph, and feature list. The structure supports progressive disclosure: overview first, then capability breakdowns in compact stacked items.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead-capture form placed immediately after the hero, inside a prominent white container. Uses hidden tracking fields plus visible form inputs, indicating a conversion-focused landing-page pattern with strong lead-gen priority.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, low-motion presentation with no obvious animated marketing behaviors in the reference HTML. Interaction appears utilitarian and form-driven rather than motion-led.
designNotes: Keep the hero concise and text-heavy.
Use a strong dark-to-light section contrast to separate acquisition and detail content.
Favor compact feature stacks over large visual modules.
Keep CTA hierarchy simple with one primary action.
Support scanning with short labels, bold headings, and checkmark-style bullets.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise content teams needing fast, high-quality image and video generation
personality.emotion: awe, control, precision, and creative momentum
personality.reasoning: This product is about advanced generative visuals, so the page should feel inventive, cinematic, and highly capable without looking playful or consumer-grade. The brand palette forces a strong orange-led identity, which works well for creativity and energy, while the black-white-neutral base keeps it premium and professional. The visual language should emphasize layered product systems, modular proof points, and interactive AI capability panels to communicate depth, speed, and enterprise readiness.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long, so it needs a reduced hero size to preserve balance and avoid awkward line breaks while still feeling premium and editorial.

colours.colourReason: The brand already defines an orange-led identity, so the hero and CTA should use #ff6b00 as the core signal of energy and action. White, black, and soft grey provide contrast and keep the layout sophisticated. No external palette is introduced.

layout.heroBackground: #ff6b00 with layered abstract AI visual on the right
layout.heroReason: The product benefits from a split hero because it can show a rich visual shell or model-inspired composition alongside the core value proposition. The orange hero background gives immediate brand ownership and strong contrast for white text and CTA buttons.
layout.featureReason: Alternating between split panels, spotlight cards, and tabbed capability blocks creates the right sense of progression for two distinct products: image generation and video generation. It also allows stronger contrast between Seedream and Seedance, preventing the page from feeling repetitive.
layout.darkSectionFor: Use one dark section for the Seedance 1.5 Pro video capability block and one for the final conversion band to create a cinematic finish and stronger separation from the white feature areas.

personality.imageryDirection: Use premium AI-inspired product visuals rather than literal stock photography: layered mock interfaces, prompt-to-image transformation states, video timeline shells, floating capability chips, and subtle generation artifacts like light trails, frame stacks, and waveform overlays. Keep compositions asymmetrical and immersive. If no real product screenshots are available, build rich CSS-based panels with orange glow accents, translucent depth layers, and metric cards.
personality.designPersonality: A cinematic, enterprise-grade creative studio aesthetic: bold orange brand energy, dark premium accents, clean white analytical sections, and layered AI interface storytelling. It should feel like a high-end generative model showcase built for decision-makers who want both artistic output and technical credibility.

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish category leadership, clarify the two-model offering, and drive immediate action with a primary CTA.
Reinforce credibility through capability badges and enterprise-readiness cues before deeper product exploration.
Explain the image-generation model as the core product with capability-first storytelling and professional use-case relevance.
Position the video-generation model as the complementary advanced module, emphasizing audio-visual synchronization and production speed.
Convert high-intent users with quote-driven commercial framing and clear package-level inclusions.
Close with social proof from relevant creative roles to reduce risk and support the conversion decision.

componentNeeds.notes: Use a strong left-aligned headline stack, concise supporting line, one primary CTA, and no secondary CTA. Keep the hero visually restrained with emphasis on typography and trust.
Present badges as compact pills in a horizontal row or wrapped row. Include only the provided AI and enterprise capability tags.
Treat as the primary product section. Use a descriptive intro block followed by feature items in concise stacked cards or bullets with clear hierarchy.
Visually parallel to Seedream but slightly lower emphasis. Maintain the same structure for consistency while making the video model feel like an adjacent offering.
Use two compact quote-oriented cards rather than a full pricing table. Keep the Seedance monthly starting price visible and make both CTAs consistent.
Use a 3-card grid on desktop and single column on mobile. Ignore the incomplete fourth testimonial entry.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a full-width dark hero band with a dense but disciplined text stack. Keep the page text-first, with no primary media panel, and use the hero to anchor the conversion path.
layoutStrategy.features: Structure the two product sections as sequential capability blocks with clear labels, headlines, descriptive copy, and compact feature lists. Favor white background, strong spacing, and simple card or list treatment over decorative layouts.
layoutStrategy.proof: Place trust badges immediately after the hero and use testimonials near the bottom as role-specific proof. Keep trust elements lightweight and factual, not promotional.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Present pricing as centered quote cards with clear inclusions and CTA emphasis. Avoid comparison-chart complexity; use quote intent instead of hard purchase mechanics.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be designed because includeForm is false. Keep conversion through CTAs only.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use the default professional brand system with a premium, high-trust treatment. Favor a dark authoritative hero, accent-led CTAs, neutral whites and greys for content sections, and restrained motion. Typography should feel modern and credible, not playful.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a single-product B2B landing page for ByteDance generative models with a dark text-first hero, immediate capability badges, sequential product explanation for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro, quote-oriented pricing cards, and role-based testimonials. Keep hierarchy linear, trust signals early, and layout utility-led with minimal ornament.

blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro | AI Image and Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Explore ByteDance's Seedream 4.5 for high-resolution AI image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro for synchronized AI video and audio creation, built for creative teams and enterprises.

sections.backgroundTreatment: Orange full-bleed hero with subtle mesh-gradient glow, soft noise texture, and translucent abstract AI visual layers on the right to create cinematic depth.
sections.designNote: Use a strong left-aligned headline stack with compact supporting copy and two CTAs. Keep the right side immersive with layered mock UI panels, prompt-to-output transformations, and floating capability chips. This section should feel premium, high-energy, and instantly recognizable as a generative AI product.

Place a slim, high-clarity trust strip immediately after the hero with compact badge pills and small utility icons. Keep it restrained and enterprise-oriented, reinforcing multimodal capability, audio-video generation, and enterprise readiness without visual clutter.

Organize the two product blocks as alternating visual sections. For Seedream 4.5, use a white spotlight panel with a preview shell on one side and a compact capability grid on the other, emphasizing image quality, typography, and multi-image composition. For Seedance 1.5 Pro, switch to a dark cinematic block to create contrast and spotlight audio-visual synchronization, lip-sync, and fast inference. Because both products have many features, use a spotlight-plus-grid structure with a strong preview panel rather than a dense text list.

Even though no why-section content is provided, reserve a dark credibility block for optional enterprise proof or implementation benefits. Present it as a concise icon-led card grid with high contrast. If content remains empty, treat this as a structural spacer or omit in implementation.

Use a two-card pricing display with one emphasized card for Seedance 1.5 Pro and a cleaner utility card for Seedream 4.5. Keep prices and inclusions highly scannable. Use orange accent fills for the primary conversion card, with subtle borders and clear Get Quote CTAs. This should feel commercial and decision-ready.

Because there are 4 testimonials, use a carousel to avoid repetition and maintain rhythm. Style quotes as clean editorial cards with strong author hierarchy and minimal decoration. Prioritize the most persuasive testimonials from creative and video roles, and de-emphasize any incomplete or placeholder entry.

Place a dedicated conversion form in a centered floating card immediately after testimonials. Keep the form short and premium, with clear labeling, tight spacing, and a bold orange submit button. This section should feel like the final action step and stay visually clean to reduce friction.

Use this area only if partner/publication logos become available. Otherwise, omit or repurpose as a subtle footer-like credibility strip. Keep it low-height and unobtrusive so it does not compete with the lead form.
